summary: Each person meets privately with their manager, and afterward a career-help provider explains services.
realLife: HR guidance says managers meet affected employees one by one within a short window, with counselors on site and an outplacement provider meeting people afterward.
sources: SHRM, Layoffs require communication, compassion, compliance: https://www.shrm.org/mena/topics-tools/news/talent-acquisition/layoffs-require-communication-compassion-compliance
inGame: Job-ended event written by the jobs module; outplacement does not exist, so it needs: an outplacement or help scene. Scene: needs a producer for layoff-terms.

turns.summary: The employer tells everyone together in one big meeting.
turns.writesBack: Everyone hears at once, and coworkers lean on each other.

turns.summary: The employer ends the meeting and offers no help finding work.
turns.writesBack: The worker searches alone, and the tie cools.

turns.summary: The worker hears the news but decides to look for work without the help provider.
pulledBy: a worker with a work contact
turns.writesBack: The search goes on a different path, and the journal notes the choice.
